findings.description: isPositiveNumber(fields.min_qty) is computed twice — once in the first `if` block (line 294) and again inside the `else if` condition on line 299 — instead of storing the boolean once. Purely a micro-redundancy on a cheap pure function; has no correctness or measurable performance impact.
findings.recommendation: Optional: hoist `const minQtyValid = isPositiveNumber(fields.min_qty);` once and reuse it in both branches for slightly tighter code. Not worth blocking on.

findings.description: Error-message wording for base_minutes uses "База/мин" (slash) while the existing edit-row UI label for the same field elsewhere in the file uses "База, мин" (comma) (Panel.jsx:1114). Cosmetic inconsistency only — these add-form validation messages aren't wired to any UI yet (that's Wave 3), so it's cheap to align now or fix when Wave 3 builds GarmentAddForm.
findings.recommendation: When Wave 3 wires the add-form, make sure the field label and its validation-error text use the same punctuation/wording so the two don't visually clash on screen.

findings.description: DeleteRowButton's className string duplicates most of settingsInputClass's border/background/focus-ring tokens by hand rather than composing off the shared constant (adds hover states and a different text color, drops w-full and placeholder styling, which is legitimate given it's a button not an input — but the shared border/background/focus-ring tokens are copy-pasted rather than referenced).
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. If a second button ever needs this same muted/outline treatment, consider extracting a small shared base class (e.g. `settingsButtonMutedClass`) rather than a third copy-paste.
